svg.text: Where more effort pays, and where it stops
Each line is one model; each dot is an effort level, larger for more effort. Up and to the left is better.
Across: API cost per task, log scale. Up: score. Filled: worth trying. Hollow: a cheaper setting scores as well.

Scores less than 3 points (21 Elo) apart count as a tie, and the cheaper setting wins. Filled and hollow compare settings inside the benchmark shown.
“Cheaper” means a lower API cost per task on that benchmark, which only approximates quota use. Every other benchmark and verdict: the tables under this chart.
